note: Measured geometry of this robot cell, read by tools/cell.py. Each entry: value and how it was obtained. Recalibrate after moving the robot, the mat or the gripper.

mat_z_mm.how: TCP z (base frame, FK) when the jaw tips touch the mat: grasp FK z -32.3 mm with the lowest jaw tip measured 6 mm above the mat (depth camera); FK height differences matched measured jaw-tip heights within 2 mm over 50 mm

hover_dz_mm.how: TCP height above the mat at the hover: jaw tips about 57 mm above the mat, brick fully in the wrist view

scan_up_mm.how: scan pose height above the hover (the scan pose sees the whole work area)

tip_final_mm.how: jaw-tip height above the mat when closing on a brick standing on the mat (below the brick's mid-height, above the mat)

min_tip_mm.how: lowest jaw-tip height above the mat any descent may reach by FK (keeps the jaws off the mat with the FK error measured, 2 mm)

yaw_per_roll_deg.how: brick yaw seen in the wrist camera per wrist-roll unit, measured by rolling over a still brick

gripper_empty_closed.how: gripper position read back after closing on nothing (runs any_1731, any_1740)

gripper_held_min.how: smallest gripper position read back after closing on a brick in the same runs (2x2 and 2x4 read 1.57-2.42); a hold is accepted above the midpoint to the empty reading

reach_r_mm.how: bricks are picked between these distances from the pan axis: closer, the arm folds over its base; further, no top-down grasp is reachable (kin.ik)

spot_hover_q.how: taught top-down hover pose (normalised joints): the tool pitch and IK seed of every hover

carry_dz_mm.how: TCP height above the mat while carrying a brick to a plate (clears bricks on the mat and the plate rims)

release_clearance_mm.how: the held brick's bottom this high above the mat at the release over a plate (plates are a few mm thick: the brick drops about a centimetre)

rest_q.how: taught folded rest pose (normalised joints): the arm rests here with torque off

up_q_tail.how: joints 2-5 of the taught pose the arm first rises to before folding, base joint unchanged (never a low sweep)

plate_radius_mm.how: radius of the plates (both the same), measured with a ruler; when set, a plate whose rim the scan sees only a short arc of is still placed on (centre fitted with this radius)
